verdict.rationale: Snowflake gives indirect, glancing support for this story. dbt Projects on Snowflake covers a develop/deploy/orchestrate/observe lifecycle for transformations, the Snowflake CLI can create, manage and update apps, and Time Travel can restore deleted objects. None of this documents explicit versioning, change review, or rollback of automations themselves; Time Travel concerns data and dropped objects, not automation definitions. Missing for 10: explicit version history for automations (tasks, pipelines, dbt projects), review or approval workflow before deploying changes, documented rollback to a prior automation version, and independent hands-on corroboration.
